summary:
The Western Cape has no provincial law or municipal by-law that bars transgender people from gender-segregated facilities; access is decided venue by venue, by the operator's own rules and by the staff enforcing them. On 19 February 2025 Taswald Ruiters, a transgender woman from Eerste River, was threatened with removal from the Green Point Athletic Stadium in Cape Town after using the women's bathroom. A security guard told her "Look at you, you're a man", directed her to the men's bathroom and said he had the final say. Police were called four times and had not arrived after nearly three hours. The stadium is a public facility operated by the City of Cape Town; on the day it was rented by Western Province Athletics, which was responsible for the security services on site.

The incident records a gap between the absence of any provincial restriction on facility access and the response a visibly trans person actually received in the province's best-resourced metro. The Western Cape stands under the national framework of South Africa; the constitutional guarantees, the criminal-law position, the hate-crime statute, legal gender recognition and gender-affirming care are national provisions carried by the national record, and the provincial layer neither adds to nor subtracts from them.
tangentialFactors:
The security staff involved at the Green Point Athletic Stadium were engaged by Western Province Athletics, which had rented the publicly owned venue for the day, rather than by the City of Cape Town directly. The conduct therefore does not by itself establish municipal policy on facility access, and a complaint would run against the renting body as well as the municipal operator.

No other provincial-level factor bearing on trans visitors was identified in the source inventory; the Western Cape's trans-relevant law is the national framework applied locally.
localsOnly:
Residents of the Western Cape face the same venue-by-venue facility rules as visitors, and the same gap in response. The 19 February 2025 incident at the Green Point Athletic Stadium involved a Cape Town resident, Taswald Ruiters of Eerste River, who was challenged by a security guard and then waited nearly three hours after four calls to police without a response.

For residents seeking redress, the split between the municipal operator of a public venue and the club or body renting it determines who is answerable for security staff conduct; at the Green Point stadium that responsibility sat with Western Province Athletics on the day.
outOfScopeNotes:
The source inventory records no disciplinary, criminal or civil consequence for the security guard or for either body responsible for the stadium on 19 February 2025, and no explanation from the City of Cape Town or Western Province Athletics for the police non-response.

No provincial statute, provincial equality body or provincial hate-crime provision operating independently of the national framework appears in the inventory; whether any exists is not sourced here. No provincial-level data on violence against transgender people in the Western Cape was identified.
